title: Prevent Data Loss During Project Recovery from Corrupted JSON
taskDescription: If an unexpected app crash occurs mid-write, the project file may have trailing null bytes or incomplete JSON. Implement an atomic write strategy (.tmp + rename) and graceful recovery from the backup autosave directory.
expectedBehavior: Corrupted project loads prompt the user to recover from the latest valid autosave. Original file is never overwritten with empty state.
architecturalConstraints: Project serialization must remain owned strictly by projectStore
Must preserve unknown schema fields on round-trip
Atomic rename must handle Windows NTFS file locking
acceptanceCriteria: Corrupted JSON fixture triggers recovery dialog without crashing
Valid autosave restores tracks, clips, and markers intact
Regression test added in project persistence test suite
